**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Use runtime clock for 2FA plugin in account-settings app**

The account-settings server wires `authFnTwoFactorPlugin` to a fixed timestamp (`now: () => ACCOUNT_SETTINGS_NOW`), so TOTP verification and challenge timing are pinned to March 25, 2026 rather than real time. In manual/example usage, authenticator codes generated at the current time will consistently fail, which breaks the advertised 2FA flows outside deterministic test runs. Keep deterministic `now` only in tests and let the running server use the real clock.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve Set-Cookie when getSetCookie is unavailable**

This now unconditionally skips `set-cookie` during header copy, but cookie forwarding depends on `webResponse.headers.getSetCookie?.()` earlier. If the `Response`/`Headers` implementation lacks `getSetCookie` (common with standards-only/polyfilled fetch stacks), no cookies are set and this skip drops session cookies entirely, breaking auth flows on Express. Add a fallback path so `set-cookie` is still forwarded when `getSetCookie` is absent.
